summary: Agree Realty Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing its weighted-average common shares outstanding for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Basic weighted-average shares were 124,363,105 and 121,423,613, respectively, with diluted shares of 124,602,961 and 121,879,652 including OP Units. The filing also quantified treasury-stock-method dilution from ATM and April 2025 forward equity offerings, contributing 38,597 and 255,253 incremental shares. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or structural terms were disclosed. This is an ordinary share-count update, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
